Lessons: What Archaeology Can and Cannot Show; The Dead Sea Scrolls; Cities of the Old Testament; Inscriptions That Speak; The World of Jesus; Tombs, Coins and Everyday Life
Description: Dig into the discoveries that illuminate the world of the Bible — scrolls, inscriptions, cities and everyday objects. This course presents the evidence fairly, noting what is well-established and what is still debated, so your confidence rests on honesty as well as wonder.
RelatedBooks: Genesis; Exodus; Joshua; Daniel; Luke; Acts
